findings.F1: In the falling calm profile, the coin's 7-day unusual move grows with its 14-day return scaled by its 20-day daily swing on all three 7-day grid offsets, with Spearman 0.20, 0.27 and 0.24 (p 0.067, 0.009 and 0.024; 89, 93 and 88 cases). The top fifth of scaled 14-day returns is followed by +3.3 %, +6.5 % and +6.8 % unusual moves (day-grouped t 0.90, 2.18 and 2.78, over only 13, 11 and 12 days), so it is the most consistent of the roughly 20 angles looked at, but it rests on few independent days.
findings.F2: The scaled 7-day return grades the next 7 days in the same direction but less steadily: Spearman 0.11, 0.29 and 0.27 across the offsets, and top-fifth unusual moves of +3.1 %, +3.1 % and +5.0 % with t 0.79, 1.20 and 2.16 (13, 14 and 11 days). On the offset-0 grid, its quintile means rise from -5.4 % in the bottom quintile (scaled -1.83) to +3.1 % in the top (scaled +1.07).
findings.F3: The second half of the tested forecast, the depth below the 30-day high, does not grade the next 7 days. Its Spearman is 0.04 (p 0.72, 83 cases), and its quintile means go -2.2 %, -4.8 %, -1.6 %, +6.2 %, -4.6 % with no order. Trades by entry-forecast tercile are not ordered either: mean net +3.2 %, +6.1 %, +3.8 %.
findings.F4: Being in the falling calm profile alone gives the coin no edge: its 7-day unusual move there is -0.34 % (t -0.26, 105 cases). Grid bars with a scaled 7-day rise above 0 do better at +0.76 % (31 cases) than those at or below 0 at -2.69 % (58 cases).
findings.F5: The book's best 5 % of days (32) come with a mean coin return of +8.8 % and an average scaled 7-day rise of +1.10 going in. Its worst 5 % come with -7.6 % and a scaled 7-day move of -0.20. The book's gains sit where the recent scaled rise was large.
findings.F6: At a 14-day horizon the grading cannot be read: only 35 to 38 cases fall on 3 to 5 independent days per top fifth, and the Spearman values swing between -0.12 and +0.27.

ideas.idea: In a falling, calm market, the larger a coin's 14-day return measured in units of its usual daily swing, the more it rises over the next 7 days.
ideas.consequence: A trader buys a calm downtrending coin in proportion to how strong its two-week rise has been against its own swing, without asking how far it still stands below the month's high.
ideas.name: calm downtrend two-week scaled rise
